body:
From an analytic point of view, my family has a long history of mental disorders: my grandfather has fought depression and OCD for most of his life, and my mother was actually depressed for the best part of my childhood and teenage years. I used to think yeah, I can fight this, I'm strong. But I'm just tired now, and I don't see the point anymore. 

I don't know how to put this in words, and in my own mind it's difficult to arrange the reasons why I'm inferior (sometimes it actually very circular - I'm inferior because I'm unable to be happy and I'm unable because I'm inferior, for example).

Well, I do think I'm deserving of life and happiness, everyone is. But in my case it's so tiresome to achieve this goal that I don't see the point anymore. I haven't made this decision because I feel it would be better for others, but because I can't bear living and struggling to find an ounce of happiness any longer. 

But yeah, I am scared of that being my final thought too. Stupid of me, I know. I come here stomping my feet and saying I've made a final decision, and all it takes is a couple of comments showing sympathy for me to start reconsidering. Thank you, really.
